purpose: Historical source-attributed default-test observations, not a repository runtime census or a savings total.

method.source: Frozen production and tests at 04a; temporary synchronous counters around original waits, no added await or timer. Original await/assertion expressions verified byte-identical and source restored after each file batch.
method.boundary: Bun preload and existing doubles plus an explicit user/network namespace; loopback-only interfaces and no routes verified. No browser was launched.
method.time: Each command timed inside the shared benchmark lock. Shared-host load, warm filesystem effects and counter overhead were not controlled. Accumulated spans can overlap and include computation/IO.
method.counts: 72 runs across 71 distinct files: 70 whole files, 5 selected enrichment cases, and one additional full-client imported-await diagnostic. Original run set 1009 cases / 5337 expectations; imported diagnostic adds a repeated 28 / 70. Observation sites include zero-execution sites. Test-file counters do not census all imported timers, watchdog registrations or callback deliveries. Missing metrics remain unmeasured.
method.roles: Roles classify the original operation. Fixed-response-or-negative helpers serve different following assertions; contexts retain their scenario identity. Event-loop progress is not arbitrary asynchronous-handler completion.
method.minimum: These measurements do not prove universal minimum windows or justify replacing native negative observations. Relative scheduler opportunities and unresolved horizons are discussed in the guide.
method.integrityFailure: An initial mixed batch was rejected before any test ran because nested IIFE instrumentation changed an enclosing await expression. Its source was restored. The successful run leaves that one nested auth wait explicitly uninstrumented.
method.caseIndexes: Zero-based runner case indexes; mapped from the test callback entry ordinal. Parameterized source-name patterns retained where runner names expand placeholders. Missing per-case runner timings are null, not zero; reportedBodyMs sums only reported timings.
